title: avenula versicolor subsp. praetutiana
intro: Avenula versicolor subsp. praetutiana, commonly known as Italian meadow-grass, is a subspecies of grass within the genus Avenula. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Italian meadow-grass include wound healing, antimicrobial effects, and the potential to reduce inflammation and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
